amountWithdrawable(bytes32,address,uint2.details: Return the sum of withdrawable wei of a request an account is entitled to. This function is O(n), where n is the number of rounds of the request. This could exceed the gas limit, therefore this function should only be used for interface display and not by other contracts.

params._beneficiary: The contributor for which to query.
params._request: The request from which to query for.
params._tokenID: The ID of the token to query.

amountWithdrawable(bytes32,address,uint2.return: The total amount of wei available to withdraw.

batchRequestWithdraw(address,bytes32,uin.details: Withdraws rewards and reimbursements of multiple requests at once. This function is O(n*m) where n is the number of requests and m is the number of rounds to withdraw per request. This could exceed gas limits, therefore this function should be used only as a utility and not be relied upon by other contracts.

params._beneficiary: The address that made contributions to the request.
params._count: The number of requests to iterate. If set to 0 or a value larger than the number of request, iterates until the last request.
params._cursor: The request from which to start withdrawing.
params._roundCount: The number of rounds to iterate on each request. If set to 0 or a value larger than the number of rounds a request has, iteration for that request will stop at the last round.
params._roundCursor: The round of each request from where to start withdrawing.
params._tokenID: The token ID with funds to be withdrawn.

batchRoundWithdraw(address,bytes32,uint2.details: Withdraws rewards and reimbursements of multiple rounds at once. This function is O(n) where n is the number of rounds. This could exceed gas limits, therefore this function should be used only as a utility and not be relied upon by other contracts.

params._beneficiary: The address that made contributions to the request.
params._count: The number of rounds to iterate. If set to 0 or a value larger than the number of rounds, iterates until the last round.
params._cursor: The round from where to start withdrawing.
params._request: The request from which to withdraw contributions.
params._tokenID: The token ID with funds to be withdrawn.

challengeRequest(bytes32,string).details: Challenges the latest request of a token. Accepts enough ETH to fund a potential dispute considering the current required amount. Reimburses unused ETH. TRUSTED.

params._evidence: A link to an evidence using its URI. Ignored if not provided or if not enough funds were provided to create a dispute.
params._tokenID: The ID of the token with the request to challenge.

changeArbitrator(address,bytes).details: Change the arbitrator to be used for disputes that may be raised in the next requests. The arbitrator is trusted to support appeal periods and not reenter.

params._arbitrator: The new trusted arbitrator to be used in the next requests.
params._arbitratorExtraData: The extra data used by the new arbitrator.

changeChallengerBaseDeposit(uint256).details: Change the base amount required as a deposit to challenge a request.

params._challengerBaseDeposit: The new base amount of wei required to challenge a request.

changeGovernor(address).details: Change the governor of the token curated registry.

params._governor: The address of the new governor.

changeLoserStakeMultiplier(uint256).details: Change the percentage of arbitration fees that must be paid as fee stake by the party that lost the previous round.

params._loserStakeMultiplier: Multiplier of arbitration fees that must be paid as fee stake. In basis points.

changeMetaEvidence(string,string).details: Update the meta evidence used for disputes.

params._clearingMetaEvidence: The meta evidence to be used for future clearing request disputes.
params._registrationMetaEvidence: The meta evidence to be used for future registration request disputes.

changeRequesterBaseDeposit(uint256).details: Change the base amount required as a deposit to make a request.

params._requesterBaseDeposit: The new base amount of wei required to make a request.

changeSharedStakeMultiplier(uint256).details: Change the percentage of arbitration fees that must be paid as fee stake by parties when there isn't a winner or loser.

params._sharedStakeMultiplier: Multiplier of arbitration fees that must be paid as fee stake. In basis points.

changeTimeToChallenge(uint256).details: Change the duration of the challenge period.

params._challengePeriodDuration: The new duration of the challenge period.

changeWinnerStakeMultiplier(uint256).details: Change the percentage of arbitration fees that must be paid as fee stake by the winner of the previous round.

params._winnerStakeMultiplier: Multiplier of arbitration fees that must be paid as fee stake. In basis points.

countByStatus().details: Return the numbers of tokens with each status. This function is O(n), where n is the number of tokens. This could exceed the gas limit, therefore this function should only be used for interface display and not by other contracts.
countByStatus().return: The numbers of tokens in the list per status.

executeRequest(bytes32).details: Executes a request if the challenge period passed and no one challenged the request.

params._tokenID: The ID of the token with the request to execute.

fundAppeal(bytes32,uint8).details: Takes up to the total amount required to fund a side of an appeal. Reimburses the rest. Creates an appeal if both sides are fully funded. TRUSTED.

params._tokenID: The ID of the token with the request to fund.

getContributions(bytes32,uint256,uint256.details: Gets the contributions made by a party for a given round of a request.

getRequestInfo(bytes32,uint256).details: Gets information on a request made for a token.

params._tokenID: The ID of the queried token.

getRoundInfo(bytes32,uint256,uint256).details: Gets the information on a round of a request.

params._tokenID: The ID of the queried token.

getTokenInfo(bytes32).details: Returns token information. Includes length of requests array.

params._tokenID: The ID of the queried token.

isPermitted(bytes32).details: Return true if the token is on the list.

params._tokenID: The ID of the token to be queried.

isPermitted(bytes32).return: allowed True if the token is allowed, false otherwise.

queryTokens(bytes32,uint256,bool[8],bool.details: Return the values of the tokens the query finds. This function is O(n), where n is the number of tokens. This could exceed the gas limit, therefore this function should only be used for interface display and not by other contracts.

params._count: The number of tokens to return.
params._cursor: The ID of the token from which to start iterating. To start from either the oldest or newest item.
params._filter: The filter to use. Each element of the array in sequence means: - Include absent tokens in result. - Include registered tokens in result. - Include tokens with registration requests that are not disputed in result. - Include tokens with clearing requests that are not disputed in result. - Include disputed tokens with registration requests in result. - Include disputed tokens with clearing requests in result. - Include tokens submitted by the caller. - Include tokens challenged by the caller.
params._oldestFirst: Whether to sort from oldest to the newest item.
params._tokenAddr: A token address to filter submissions by address (optional).

queryTokens(bytes32,uint256,bool[8],bool.return: The values of the tokens found and whether there are more tokens for the current filter and sort.

requestStatusChange(string,string,addres.details: Submits a request to change a token status. Accepts enough ETH to fund a potential dispute considering the current required amount and reimburses the rest. TRUSTED.

params._addr: The Ethereum address of the token.
params._symbolMultihash: The multihash of the token symbol.

rule(uint256,uint256).details: Give a ruling for a dispute. Can only be called by the arbitrator. TRUSTED. Overrides parent function to account for the situation where the winner loses a case due to paying less appeal fees than expected.

params._disputeID: ID of the dispute in the arbitrator contract.
params._ruling: Ruling given by the arbitrator. Note that 0 is reserved for "Not able/wanting to make a decision".

submitEvidence(bytes32,string).details: Submit a reference to evidence. EVENT.

params._evidence: A link to an evidence using its URI.

tokenCount().details: Return the numbers of tokens that were submitted. Includes tokens that never made it to the list or were later removed.
tokenCount().return: count The numbers of tokens in the list.

withdrawFeesAndRewards(address,bytes32,u.details: Reimburses contributions if no disputes were raised. If a dispute was raised, sends the fee stake rewards and reimbursements proportional to the contributions made to the winner of a dispute.

params._beneficiary: The address that made contributions to a request.
params._request: The request from which to withdraw.
params._round: The round from which to withdraw.
params._tokenID: The ID of the token submission with the request from which to withdraw.

devdoc.title: ArbitrableTokenList This contract is an arbitrable token curated registry for tokens, sometimes referred to as a Token² Curated Registry. Users can send requests to register or remove tokens from the registry, which can in turn, be challenged by parties that disagree with them. A crowdsourced insurance system allows parties to contribute to arbitration fees and win rewards if the side they backed ultimately wins a dispute. NOTE: This contract trusts that the Arbitrator is honest and will not reenter or modify its costs during a call. This contract is only to be used with an arbitrator returning appealPeriod and having non-zero fees. The governor contract (which will be a DAO) is also to be trusted.
